operations.name: updateUser
operations.purpose: `UpdateUserMutation` updates the authenticated user's profile and list settings.
operations.auth: Required: AniList access token (constructor `authToken` or `anilist.authToken` credential slot).

request.name: about
request.description: a string representing the updated about section of the user.

request.name: titleLanguage
request.description: a UserTitleLanguage representing the updated title language preference of the user.

request.name: displayAdultContent
request.description: a boolean representing the updated preference of the user for displaying adult content.

request.name: airingNotifications
request.description: a boolean representing the updated preference of the user for receiving airing notifications.

request.name: scoreFormat
request.description: a ScoreFormat representing the updated score format preference of the user.

request.name: rowOrder
request.description: a string representing the updated row order preference of the user.

request.name: profileColor
request.description: a string representing the updated profile color preference of the user.

request.name: donatorBadge
request.description: a string representing the updated donator badge of the user.

request.name: notificationOptions
request.description: an array of NotificationOptions representing the updated notification options of the user.

request.name: timezone
request.description: a string representing the updated timezone of the user.

request.name: activityMergeTime
request.description: a number representing the updated activity merge time of the user.

request.name: animeListOptions
request.description: a MediaListOptions representing the updated anime list options of the user.

request.name: mangaListOptions
request.description: a MediaListOptions representing the updated manga list options of the user.

request.name: staffNameLanguage
request.description: a UserStaffNameLanguage representing the updated staff name language preference of the user.

request.name: restrictMessagesToFollowing
request.description: a boolean representing the updated preference of the user for restricting messages to following.

request.name: disabledListActivity
request.description: an array of DisabledListActivity representing the updated disabled list activity preferences of the user.

operations.example:
await aniLink.anilist.mutation.updateUser({
  about: 'New about text',
  titleLanguage: 'ENGLISH',
  displayAdultContent: true,
  airingNotifications: true,
  scoreFormat: 'POINT_10',
  rowOrder: 'title',
  profileColor: 'blue',
  donatorBadge: 'Supporter',
  notificationOptions: [{type: 'AIRING', enabled: true}],
  timezone: '-06:00',
  activityMergeTime: 30,
  animeListOptions: {sectionOrder: ['title'], customLists: ['test'], advancedScoring: [], advancedScoringEnabled: false},
  mangaListOptions: {sectionOrder: ['title'], customLists: ['test'], advancedScoring: [], advancedScoringEnabled: false},
  staffNameLanguage: 'ROMAJI',
  restrictMessagesToFollowing: false,
  disabledListActivity: [{type: 'CURRENT', disabled: false}]
});
